scope: Conservative source-reviewed selections. Unmapped games remain under All. Mood describes play style, not a therapeutic or accessibility guarantee.

/luminahaven.reason: Decorating and gentle plant care, with adjustable weather, sound layers and reduced motion.

details.controls: Drag objects to arrange the room. Tap glowing forage to collect materials; use the plant and decor controls to care for and change your haven.
details.saves: The haven auto-saves on this device. The game can export and import a JSON layout.
details.accessibility: Reduced motion and calm presentation controls are available, alongside weather, lighting and sound choices.

/crownbadge.reason: Plan a watch, choose officers and decide how to handle incidents.

details.controls: Tap an officer, then an incident, or drag an officer onto a district. Keys 1–4 select officers; I selects the next call; Space advances the day.
details.saves: Continue a saved watch in this browser on this device.
details.accessibility: Reduced Stimulation stops the weather animation.

/offbrand.reason: Compare clues and use deduction while completing workshop jobs; also includes movement and quick tasks.

/touchline.reason: Plan transfers, training and match tactics.
/touchline.review_note: Reviewed current source a052c988aa8e883b346e2aae4c281d266d1fc8c243bdf92142fc0c7128e84a5b (PF-9, rulings br and by). One entry is removed from the generated-player first-name pool; transfers, training and match tactics are unchanged and still support the Thinky selection.

/cyberpulse.reason: Dodge incoming fire and time phase parries while moving through the city.

/novasiege.reason: Aim, dash and survive waves of arena enemies.

/trailrunner.reason: Steer, climb and dodge hazards on a moving trail.

/apexrally.reason: React to an opponent and time racket shots.

/rallyvector3d.reason: Steer through rally stages and react to the road.
/rallyvector3d.review_note: Reviewed current source 20ef3a2daf6bfaf67b674d90c883cced91a81b56569198b080905607836f21b1 (approved SW2 contrast revision). Six procedural rally stages and steering/control instructions still support the Fast selection.

/hyperdraft.reason: Race, draft and time boosts to overtake.

/skybreak.reason: Pilot combat sorties, track targets and evade threats.

/apextennis.reason: Position quickly and time tennis shots.

/neonturf.reason: Drive, boost and contest the ball; Local Duel supports two players on one device.

details.controls: Player one uses W/S to drive, A/D to steer, Shift to boost and Space to pulse. Player two uses the arrow keys. Touch uses the floating stick and labelled BOOST and PULSE controls.
details.players: Two players share one keyboard or use two gamepads in Local Duel. A separate same-network mode requires manual pairing.

/apexkick.reason: Take turns on one device in the 2P pass-and-play shootout.

details.players: One player, or two taking turns on the same device in the 2P shootout. There is no network play.
details.saves: Progress saves in this browser under the game’s own key. It does not use the Sports Passport.

/apexkick.review_note: Approved by Matt Roper 2026-10-21: /apexkick/ replaced by Apex Kick: World Stage V10 (intake sha256 07ed72653d180a33e5d0a9c56931ea7e28d3d7d8062f43ba161694c5a70fa826; published sha256 2a0295ce575cc2eb3b57f667b2bdcfb327112adf16a5ffbc55348ac3ba879d7d). Reviewed by Claude in chat: all nine modes played to the result screen in automated runs with zero console errors.

/auroralinks.reason: Two active golfers on two devices, with one remote peer on the same network.

details.controls: Drag across the course or use the left/right arrows to aim. Space controls the three-tap swing.
details.players: Two active players on two devices maximum, with one remote peer on the same network. Manual pairing is required; connection success depends on the devices and network.

/apexvelodrome.reason: Pass the same device between riders to compare ghost rides; no live network race.

details.controls: W/S or up/down adjust power; A/D or left/right change lane; Space sprints. On-screen controls provide the same core touch actions.
details.players: Pass the same device from rider A to rider B, or exchange ghost JSON files manually. Ghost comparison is asynchronous; there is no live LAN race.

/Lessons/Games/Neon_Garden.html.reason: Plant and cross-pollinate a garden without a clock or losing condition; ambient sound and calm presentation can be changed.

details.controls: Tap the ground to plant a seed. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, and tap a plant to inspect it.
details.saves: The garden auto-saves in this browser on this device and grows while you are away.
details.accessibility: The title screen has Ambient sound and Calm presentation controls.

/Lessons/Games/Prism.html.reason: Place and rotate optical pieces to solve colour and light puzzles, without a timer.

details.controls: Pick a piece from the tray, then tap a cell to place it. Tap a placed piece to rotate it; use the remove mode to pick pieces back up.

/Lessons/Games/Lumins.html.reason: Plan and place bridges and other tools to guide moving Lumins to the exit; pause to consider the next intervention.

/Lessons/Games/Cup_Final.html.reason: Teacher-led teams discuss and play a tournament on one shared display.

details.players: Teacher-led team play on one shared display. This is a group classroom game, not network multiplayer.

/Lessons/Games/Match_Director.html.reason: Teacher-led teams discuss and play a tournament on one shared display.

details.players: Teacher-led team play on one shared display. This is a group classroom game, not network multiplayer.

/Lessons/Games/Cup_Showdown.html.reason: Teacher-led teams discuss and play a tournament on one shared display.

details.players: Teacher-led team play on one shared display. This is a group classroom game, not network multiplayer.

/signalheist.reason: Sneak past guards and lasers, grab loot and get out before the heat rises.

details.controls: WASD or the arrow keys move, Space blinks and E or Shift drops a decoy. On touch, drag the pad to glide and tap Blink or Decoy.
details.saves: Progress, unlocks and best times save on this device only.
details.accessibility: Reduced motion follows the device setting and can be switched in Settings, which also turns off bloom and screen shake. Sound can be muted.

/layerpress.reason: Layer masks and inks at your own pace to match a printed design. No timers.

details.controls: WASD or the arrow keys move the mask, Q and E turn it, Space rolls ink and Enter peels. On touch or with a mouse, tap the tools and the bench.
details.saves: Stars, best scores, your rail of prints and settings save on this device only.
details.accessibility: Calm Mode follows the device's reduced-motion setting and can be switched on the title screen, in the game and in Settings. Sound can be muted and each volume set.

/magnetmates.reason: Two pods share one magnetic band, so it plays best with a friend on one keyboard, or with the AI mate.

details.controls: Player one uses WASD and Space, player two the arrow keys and Enter. B brings in the AI mate. On touch, each side of the screen moves one pod; a mouse moves and clicks.
details.saves: Stars, best scores, career stats, unlocks and settings save on this device only.
details.accessibility: Calm Mode follows the device's reduced-motion setting and can be switched on the title screen, in the game, in the pause menu and in Settings. Sound can be muted and each volume set.

/hillhound.reason: Steering a flock is a thinking puzzle: read where the sheep will drift, sweep wide behind them and sort each kind into its own pen.

details.controls: WASD, the arrow keys or the cursor move the sheepdog; Shift stalks, Space or a click barks and R whistles. On touch, a pad moves the dog and on-screen buttons stalk, bark and whistle.
details.saves: Stars, best scores, stats, unlocked bandanas and settings save on this device only.
details.accessibility: Calm Mode follows the device's reduced-motion setting and can be switched on the title screen, in the pause menu and in Settings. Sound can be muted and each volume set.

/skyseeder.reason: Glide at your own pace, seeding bare islands and riding the wind. Nothing crashes you, and Calm Mode takes away the clock.

details.controls: WASD or the arrow keys steer, Space drops a seed, R levels the wings and Esc pauses. With a mouse the glider follows the cursor; on touch a thumb pad steers and the Seed button drops a seed.
details.saves: Stars, unlocked gliders, the golden dusk sky and settings save on this device only.
details.accessibility: Calm Mode follows the device's reduced-motion setting and can be switched on the title screen, in the pause menu and in Settings; it levels the wings and removes the flight clock. Sound can be muted and each volume set.

/liftshift.reason: Every load is a balancing sum: pair heavy bots with floaty crates, then judge the brake to land flush at the floor each rider's shape asks for.

details.controls: W and S or the up and down arrows drive the cab, Space brakes and opens the doors, 1 to 5 pick a floor and Esc pauses. On touch or with a mouse, tap a floor, the cab or the Up, Doors and Down buttons.
details.saves: Stars, best scores, stats, unlocked cabs and themes and settings save on this device only.
details.accessibility: Calm Mode follows the device's reduced-motion setting and can be switched on the title screen, in the game, in the pause menu and in Settings. Sound can be muted and each volume set.

/rutline.reason: Open the throttle across a whole valley of trails, ramps and roads. Rider Assist is on by default, so a rough landing is a wobble and every job can be retried or skipped.

details.controls: W is throttle, S the rear brake and Space the front brake; A and D steer, Shift and C lean back and forward, and Esc opens the menu. On touch a steer stick sits on the left with Gas, brake and boost buttons on the right.
details.saves: Credits, story progress, best times, found parts, bike tunes and settings save on this device only.
details.accessibility: Rider Assist self-levels the bike and softens landings, and is on by default. A Relaxed setting removes job timers, the graphics tier can be lowered, and sound can be muted.
